name: hud_scoreboard_set_scale_and_rebuild
description: HudScoreboard::SetScaleAndRebuild applies a scale to the HUD stats triplet layout and rebuilds the visible scoreboard rows.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?SetScaleAndRebuild@HudScoreboard@@YGXM@Z at 0x40eab0 produced zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 16 relocation bytes and trimming 12 VC NOP bytes; BN body is 36 bytes and the VC object symbol is 48 bytes. The same target also verifies g_HudUiMgrStatsList at 0x4ed4e0 as a 4-byte zero-initialized BSS pointer with zero unmasked data-byte mismatches.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40eab0 validates loading g_HudUiMgrStatsList->triplet, calling HudUiTriplet::InterpolateLayout(scale), reloading g_HudUiMgrStatsList->triplet, and calling HudUiTriplet::RebuildDisplay.

Native smoke zhud_scoreboard_set_scale_and_rebuild_smoke installs a constructed triplet as g_HudUiMgrStatsList->triplet, calls SetScaleAndRebuild(0.5f), and verifies interpolated layout values plus empty-row rebuild hiding.
